```{bash}
## Local Host Keys
cd ~/.ssh 
cat ~/.ssh/known_hosts
## Create a Key PD2026.
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f ~/.ssh/id_TBB
## Add the Key to the agent
ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_TBB
## Copy the Key to the server
cat ~/.ssh/id_TBB.pub | pbcopy

## Creating folder for keys in the server
echo "paste_your_public_key_here" >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 600 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys
```

```{bash}
## Connecting with Github
DEV_TBB_Lab
```
